title: Qman DirectPath live external-anchor freshness envelope
description: A short-lived root-signed response from the independent monotonic authority to a verifier-supplied nonce. A copied anchor file or nonce contained only in release artifacts is not freshness proof.
x-qmanFreshnessRule: The verifier generates verifierNonce from at least 128 bits of fresh randomness and supplies it directly to the independent authority and release evaluator; it is never read from the map, target repository or evidence repository. The authority reads its current committed monotonic record after receiving that nonce and returns this envelope. observedAt <= signedAt <= min(expiresAt,evaluatorTime+30 seconds), expiresAt-observedAt <= 300 seconds, and evaluator time is inside that interval. subjectId, anchor bytes/hash/schema, digest and versions byte-equal the live record.
x-qmanUsageSeparationRule: Each security-relevant read uses a distinct verifier nonce. In HostSnapshot publication, the request's predecessor-anchor read, rollback-authority zero-unresolved preflight, post-decision/finalization read, and outbox dispatch read are separate challenges and receipts; one envelope or nonce cannot be replayed across those phases.
x-qmanDigestAndSignatureRule: Set freshnessReceiptDigest to null and rootSignatures to [], retain every other field, and hash CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes into freshnessReceiptDigest. Each root signature covers ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/ANCHOR-FRESHNESS/V1) || 0x00 || CANONICAL-JSON-V1({rootKeyId,signedAt,freshnessReceiptDigest}). Distinct root principal/key material satisfies the independently supplied root-set quorum.
x-qmanAuthorityRule: The authority, nonce transport and current-record read are independent of target code, DirectPath control/database, map publisher and evidence repository. Without a matching live nonce response, the verifier may prove a historical signature but must report freshness=NOT_PROVEN and QUALIFIED/release remain false.
